name: A Spoonful of Sugar
source:
You're living the dream. No worries, no job, no responsibilities. Just you, the basement, and a Steam library the size of Alexandria. 

There's just one problem; your pain in the ass parents. 

Move out? Get a job? Clean your room? Their ridiculous demands keep coming! And as if that's not bad enough, now they've hired a nanny, Mary Poppins, to hold you to them! Well, that just won't do. 

Each day, you can manipulate Mary into 'rewarding' your cleaning with something suitable to your adult, refined tastes... and each night, you can re-trash your room, to make sure that there's plenty more work to be done tomorrow. 

[From [url=https://shagamon.itch.io/a-spoonful-of-sugar]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在实现梦想。没有烦恼，没有工作，没有责任。只有你、地下室和亚历山大大小的Steam库。

只有一个问题；你的父母很痛苦。

搬出去？找到工作吗？打扫你的房间吗？他们的荒谬要求不断出现！好像这还不够糟糕，现在他们还雇了一位保姆，玛丽·波宾斯，来把你抱在怀里！好吧，那是不行的。

每天，你都可以操纵玛丽，用一些适合你成人、高雅品味的东西来“奖励”你的清洁工作……每天晚上，你都可以重新清理你的房间，以确保明天还有更多的工作要做。

[来自[url=https://shagamon.itch.io/a-spoonful-of-sugar]itch.io[/url]]
